title: Provability Fabric local/runtime environment
description: Documented PF_* and service URL variables for local compose and SDK clients. See docs/dev/local-workflows.md.

PF_PROFILE.description: Runtime posture. production enables MCP fail-closed and stricter auth paths.

PROFILE.description: Ledger bootstrap profile (alias consumed alongside PF_PROFILE).

PORT.description: Service listen port (ledger default 4000, sidecar default 8006).

SIDECAR_URL.description: Ledger MCP → sidecar. Local default http://localhost:8006; compose http://runtime-sidecar:8006.

LEDGER_URL.description: Sidecar → ledger. Local default http://localhost:4000; compose http://ledger:4000.

KERNEL_URL.description: Tool-broker → policy kernel/sidecar. Local default http://localhost:8006.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string for ledger / evidence services.

PF_ENFORCE_DSSE.description: When 1, enforce DSSE verification on receipt paths.

PF_ENABLED_TOOLS.description: Comma-separated MCP tool allow-list (empty = deny-by-default policy source).

TENANT_ID.description: Default demo tenant for local sidecar.
